Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
A kingfisher works the far bank, patient as a tax collector. It catches something silver and is gone before you can envy it properly.
🤒 Petra is on the mend — the fever broke.
📓 Codex: The old argument between Logan and Ifeanyi ended — one of them is gone.
📨 Word came: a lean teacher wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
🤒 Petra is on the mend — the fever broke.
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
🤒 Benoit is on the mend — the fever broke.
🤒 Rosa is on the mend — the fever broke.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
🤒 Grace is on the mend — the fever broke.
